title: Tree crowns catch the light
items: Woodland and street trees, woody shrubs and vines have rounded foliage shading and warmer backlit leaves. Sunlight passing through leaves follows the shadows. Full adds smaller, layered sprays on fine twigs within 14 metres; capable devices show fine leaf relief. Balanced and Light use smaller woodland textures; their tree meshes retain their existing detail. Switching season and detail safely rebuilds the crowns.
